outcome: Plasma concentrations of 29 cytokines (IL-16, IL-6, IL-12/IL-23p40, MCP-1, IL-1β)
cohort: 108 pregnant women (36 with PPH and 72 matched controls)
finding: Pregnant women with severe PPH had higher median maternal plasma concentrations of IL-16, IL-6, IL-12/IL-23p40, MCP-1, and IL-1β than patients without PPH.
